description: Free, no sign-in: fetch a public page as a first-time visitor and check its Google Consent Mode v2 setup — whether gtag.js or Google Tag Manager is present, whether a consent default is set before the tags load, the default values of ad_storage, analytics_storage, ad_user_data and ad_personalization, whether wait_for_update, url_passthrough and ads_data_redaction are used, whether a consent banner is detected, and which tags fire before consent. Returns pass / warning / fail per check with plain-language fixes and copy-paste default snippets. It also reads the consent banner's own settings and, in country_rules, checks the banner rules that can be tested from outside for Italy (Garante 2021 guidelines) and Spain (AEPD cookie guide, July 2023 update), each with its source and a fix (automatic check, not legal advice). Static check (no JavaScript runs), so consent updates after a click aren't visible. Shares the free quota of 10 checks per hour per visitor with pre_consent_scan.

lang.description: Language of the report's text: en (default) or nl (Dutch, with Dutch study figures).

url.description: Public page to check, e.g. https://example.com

name: consent_mode_check
title: Check Google Consent Mode v2 setup (free)
